description: Land Title Settlement Department - Sandalankawa, Pannala D/S Division, Kurunegala District Case. No. 420505 (24/0938)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels (Parcel No. 121 and Parcel No. 03), including details about land ownership, extent, location, and encumbrances. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazette category as it involves land registration, title determination, and property ownership matters without any government personnel changes or structural administrative modifications.
